name: Perfect Chemistry
source:
Cammy, sarcastic but hopeful, is a first year college student. She and her lab partner Tyler get along well…maybe a little too well. Does he like her? Or are they too comfortable for that? Does it even matter–she might not even like him that way! When Tyler’s ex-girlfriend comes back into the picture, Cammy has to figure out what she really wants. Will she embrace her innate nerdy quirks see the simple beauty of reality? Or does she unleash her inner princess as she tries to pursues her fairy tale?

[From [URL=http://renai.us/game/perfect-chemistry.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/URL]]
